question.en: What did the man in this story do?
question.zh: 这个故事里的人做了什么？

sentences.en: What did the man in this story do?
sentences.zh: 这个故事里的人做了什么？

sentences.en: When a plane from London arrived at Sydney airport,
sentences.zh: 当一架从伦敦飞来的飞机抵达悉尼机场时，

sentences.en: workers began to unload a number of wooden boxes which contained clothing.
sentences.zh: 工人们开始卸下大批装着衣服的木箱子。

chunks.x: of wooden boxes which contained clothing

sentences.en: No one could account for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy.
sentences.zh: 其中一个箱子特别重，谁也解释不清其中的原因。

chunks.x: for the fact that one of the boxes was extremely heavy

sentences.en: It suddenly occurred to one of the workers to open up the box.
sentences.zh: 一个工人突然想到打开箱子看看。

sentences.en: He was astonished at what he found.
sentences.zh: 看到里面的东西他大吃一惊。

sentences.en: A man was lying in the box on top of a pile of woollen goods.
sentences.zh: 一个人正躺在箱子里的一堆毛织品上面。

chunks.x: on top of a pile of woollen goods
of a pile of woollen goods

sentences.en: He was so surprised at being discovered
sentences.zh: 被人发现使他非常吃惊，

sentences.en: that he did not even try to run away.
the man admitted hiding in the box before the plane left London.
sentences.zh: 这个人承认在飞机离开伦敦前就藏进了箱子。

sentences.en: He had had a long and uncomfortable trip,
sentences.zh: 他经历了一次漫长而难受的旅行，

sentences.en: for he had been confined to the wooden box for over eighteen hours.
sentences.zh: 因为他在木箱里被关了十八个多小时。

sentences.en: The man was ordered to pay ￡3, 500 for
sentences.zh: 这个人被责令支付3,500英镑，

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: The normal price of a ticket is ￡2, 000!
sentences.zh: 而一张机票的正常价格是2,000英镑！
